name: calculate
description: Evaluate a mathematical expression. Supports arithmetic, scientific functions, complex numbers, units, algebra, statistics, matrices and calculus. Translate the request into a mathematical expression; never calculate the answer yourself.

expression.description: The mathematical expression to evaluate, for example 1+1, sqrt(16), sin(pi/2), 5 km to miles. Preserve all numbers and operators from the request.

name: unsupported
description: Reject requests unrelated to mathematics, such as weather, greetings, news, or programming. Also use when no calculation is specified.
